__broaden__.cui: quī, quae, quod — who, which; cui, to whom (rel., dat. sg.) · also interrog., to/for whom? (cui fāta parent)
__broaden__.danai: Danaī, -ōrum (m. pl.) — the Danaans, the Greeks (nom. pl.) · also voc. pl. (Danaī, venistis)
__broaden__.ferentis: ferō, ferre, tulī, lātum — to bear, carry; to bear aloft (pres. part., m. acc. pl., = ferentēs) · also m. gen. sg. (animī … ferentis, of a spirit enduring)

__broaden__.miseri: miser, misera, miserum — wretched, unhappy, pitiable (m. nom. pl.) · also voc. pl. (ō miserī) · also m. gen. sg. (ūnius in miserī exitium)

__broaden__.prius: prius (adv.) — before, sooner, earlier (nec prius… quam, not before… than) · also rather, sooner (quod dī prius ōmen … convertant)
__broaden__.quae: quī, quae, quod — who, which (rel., f. nom. sg.; f./n. nom./acc. pl.) · interrog. adj., what? which? (f. nom. sg.: quae sententia) · also interrog. adj., n. nom. pl. (quae sint ea nūmina)
__broaden__.quo: quī, quae, quod — who, which, what (rel. or interrog., m./n. abl. sg.); quō (adv.), where to · also indef. after nē, any (abl. sg.: nē quō nūmine) · also quō, to what end? why? (quō molem … statuēre?)
__broaden__.quod: quī, quae, quod — which (rel., n. nom./acc. sg.); quod (conj.), because, that · also interrog. adj., what? (n. nom./acc. sg.: quod genus) · also acc. of respect, wherefore (quod tē per superōs … ōrō)
__broaden__.sacrata: sacrō, -āre — to consecrate, hallow (perf. pass. part., f. abl. sg.) · also n. acc. pl. (sacrāta … iūra)
__broaden__.troia: Trōius, -a, -um — Trojan, of Troy (f. nom. sg.; n. nom./acc. pl.) · Trōia, -ae (f.) — Troy (abl. sg., from Troy) · also nom. sg., Troy (servātaque serves Trōia fidem)
__broaden__.vires: vīs (f.) — force; pl. vīrēs, strength (acc. pl.) · also nom. pl. (fractae vīrēs)
__broaden__.vos: tū, vōs — you (2nd pers. pl. pron.) (nom./acc. pl.) · also voc. pl. (vōs, aetērnī ignēs)
